name: Lair

components.pose: The dragon lies like a mountain on a bed of ore, heavy limbs folded beneath it, head raised and turned toward the camera with a slow, unshakable gaze.
components.background: a deep cavern of giant crystal geodes and carved stone halls, warm dust-gold light from glowing veins of ore, hanging stalactites
components.hoard: mounds of raw gemstones and cut geodes, gold nuggets and ore carts, antique bronze statues, carved stone tablets, turquoise and amber, ancient mining tools
components.effects: A few fine motes of dust drift in the warm light - understated, nothing busy.

denoise: n/a — full text-to-image, no incoming reference
notes: Daily-post lair shot: the dragon at rest on the kind of hoard its element would collect.
